pairs.subject: modal-stack
pairs.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 hard-deletes a template with no confirm or undo and closes at :311 before the await settles, so failure is only logged (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/useGalleryActions.ts:207); 5 of 5 judged techniques fail (anchored-positioning unjudged: no anchored overlay in this context)

techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/useModalStack.ts:25 is a second, feature-private stack beside the app registry, closed by type not id (:37); CompareModal and the credential modal bypass even that door (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/GeneratedReviewsTab.tsx:62, src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:112), and the app registry entries carry no kind (src/lib/ui/ModalStackContext.tsx:13), so nothing outside can ask what is open

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:283 backdrop click and Escape (:199-201) call one unguarded onClose: () => void, so RebuildModal's typed direction is discarded by a stray click and callers cannot tell cancel from dismiss from complete

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:231 restores focus only on the isOpen flip, but RebuildModal and the credential modals close by unmounting with isOpen hard-wired true (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateModals.tsx:62), so focus drops to the document root; aria-modal at src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:289 is declared on the table-scoped detail modal with no inert marking on the rest of the app

src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx:177 fuses detachment and precedence in one portal flag (base 50 vs 10000, :9), and TemplateDetailModal writes a raw z-50 at the use site (src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:145)

src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/modals/TemplateDetailModal.tsx:310 deletes immediately with no confirm or undo, closes optimistically at :311, and the failure is only logged at src/features/templates/sub_generated/gallery/cards/useGalleryActions.ts:207
